note: Fails if `period` stops selecting the segments that overlap it (2020 is only the svar20 segment) or clips them, if `value_set_name` stops matching a source's name for the value set exactly (svar18 is only the 2018-2019 segment), or if `table` stops narrowing to one table of the variable's register (Svar has no segment in table r: an empty page, not an error).
